purpose: Validation-only causal topological replay of frozen GSE observations and fixed baselines, selecting one pre-registered structural configuration without reading strict-test or M-TARE worlds.

approval.scope: After frozen three-seed training and perception qualification both seal PASS, execute one immutable 10-world C09 offline topology replay: 243 fixed graph configurations for complete GSE, GSE with rule association, exit-only rule graph and non-learning geometry rule graph. Zero model updates, C10 or M-TARE reads.
approval.confirmation_reference: The user granted standing authorization for the fixed GSE-Graph paper program, asked not to request repeated approvals, and required continuous execution with paper figures retained.

raw_sources: Sealed PASS GSE deduplicated dataset V1 containing the exact 10 validation Zarr shards and sequence manifest.
Sealed PASS GSE Teacher manifest V1 containing validation traversal, event identity and association evidence.
Sealed PASS V1R three-seed GSE validation outputs and its immutable evidence seal.
Sealed PASS perception qualification containing calibration contracts and frozen M1D exit-only outputs.
excluded_sources: GT identity as a graph-builder input
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project procedural worlds and derived LiDAR/Teacher/model evidence with complete provenance.

sampling.rule: Each validation parent is one independent unit. Its 24,462 anchors are consumed in deterministic directed-traversal Euler order; each model observation uses only its five-frame causal history. Parameter copies and three model seeds are repeated measurements, not new independent samples.

teacher.source: Sealed TNG event/node/edge identities define an evaluator-only corridor-compressed structural graph; sealed spline/mesh Teacher supplies the objective typed labels but never enters the graph builder.
teacher.valid_mask: Only observations already accepted by the sealed dataset Teacher masks are scored. Repeated predicted nodes, duplicate edges and unmapped edges remain in precision denominators.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Graph builders receive only current/past typed observations and current replay pose. Nodes are event-triggered or metric anchors; edges appear only after a recorded physical traversal. GT identity and future routes remain evaluator-only.

split.historical_pollution_audit: The ten C09 parents are development validation only and may select calibration and graph parameters. All C10 and M-TARE worlds remain excluded until one configuration and all thresholds are frozen.

methods.main: Frozen GSE semantic observations with learned descriptor association, uncertainty rejection and execution-verified edges.
baselines: Frozen exit-only M1D observations plus rule association
Deterministic non-learning geometry events plus rule association
methods.ablation: The same frozen GSE observations with descriptor-free distance/angle rule association.
methods.oracle: GT-TNG identity-aware diagnostic only; it cannot be selected or presented as a deployable upper bound.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.grid: Exactly 3^5=243 structural settings for every method/seed under the frozen ranges in docs/GSE_GRAPH_RESEARCH_PLAN_V1.md.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.selection: GSE association-safe first, then lexicographic node/edge fidelity and invariant error. Baselines use the same graph-fidelity ordering without hiding unsafe association.
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.scientific_gate: GSE node F1 and edge F1 must each exceed the stronger corresponding deployable baseline by at least 0.05; association attempts must be nonzero with precision >=0.98 and false-loop rate <=0.01; absolute mean signed connected-component and cycle-rank errors must each be <=0.25.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU replay of 59,442,660 typed-observation updates across 24,300 world/config/seed replays; zero GPU inference, training or optimizer steps.

evidence.machine_metrics: Complete parameter sweeps, unique selected configuration, per-world/seed nodes, edges, decision traces, association counts, topology invariants, GT-TNG diagnostic, logs, state and SHA-256 seal.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Paper-ready node/edge F1, invariant and association figure plus selected topology overlays generated only from a sealed PASS.
evidence.failure_policy: Any source/tool drift, forbidden read, non-bijective replay population, unsafe learned association, less than 0.05 node or edge gain, invariant bias, non-reproducible selected replay or resource overrun is FAIL with no retuning or retry.
